description: This Dart file defines a utility class Env for accessing environment variables related to API endpoints and keys, utilizing the flutter_dotenv package.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class providing static getters for environment variables such as API base URL and API keys.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables or a default value.

methods.name: stripePublishableKey
methods.description: Returns the Stripe publishable key from environment variables or a default value.

methods.name: googleMapsKey
methods.description: Returns the Google Maps API key from environment variables or an empty string.
